description:
Create a 3D construction in GeoGebra demonstrating the famous hexagonal cross-section of a cube. 

1. Open the 3D Graphics view.
2. Construct a cube of side length 2 with one vertex at the origin (0,0,0) and the opposite vertex at (2,2,2).
3. Construct a plane that passes through the center of the cube (1,1,1) and is perpendicular to the space diagonal connecting (0,0,0) and (2,2,2).
4. Create the polygon representing the intersection (cross-section) of the cube and the plane.
5. Measure and display the area of this hexagonal cross-section using a text annotation.

Save your project as 'cube_hexagon.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/
